dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid light-intensity pixel clusters is observed primarily on the lateral flanks, appearing as asymmetrical flecks without internal gradients or central voids.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli on the mid-dorsal surface form an elongated scalene triangle with the primary axis aligned longitudinally with the spine.
